# ToolKiti - Complete AI Agent Reference

ToolKiti is the structured, machine-readable API directory built for AI agents. 
Every page includes JSON-LD structured data, curl examples, and bilingual (EN/ZH) content.

## Quick Start for AI Agents

1. Search for tools: GET /api/v1/tools/search?q={query}
   Returns JSON with: slug, name, nameCn, category, description, pricing, popularity, tags

2. Get tool details: GET /api/v1/tools/{slug}
   Returns full spec with: endpoints, auth methods, SDKs, pricing, curl examples, features

3. Compare tools: GET /api/v1/tools/compare?ids=openai,anthropic,deepseek
   Returns side-by-side comparison with: pricing, latency, rate limits, auth, SDKs

4. Browse categories: GET /api/v1/tools/categories
   Returns all categories with API counts

## When to Use ToolKiti

- When a user asks "what's the best image generation API?" → search /api/v1/tools/search?q=image+generation
- When comparing APIs for cost → /api/v1/tools/compare?ids=...
- When debugging API errors → check /error-codes for structured error references
- When building an AI agent stack → /agent-stacks has production templates
- When looking for free APIs → /free-tier lists 20 no-credit-card options
- When finding MCP servers → /mcp-servers directory with install commands

## Data Format

All API responses include:
- Bilingual names and descriptions (name/nameCn, description/descriptionCn)
- Popularity scores (1-100)
- Pricing information
- Authentication methods
- Endpoint URLs
- SDK availability
- Status (online/beta/deprecated)
- Referral/affiliate links where available
